ops.title: Security default: strip provider API keys from subprocess environment
ops.body:
# Security default: provider API keys never reach the child by default

Since `3538597959e2` (v0.10.0), spawnllm strips each provider's API-key env vars from every spawned provider process unless the caller opts out. A stray exported `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`/`OPENAI_API_KEY` can no longer silently flip billing from the logged-in subscription (claude.ai plan, ChatGPT plan, Google login) to per-token API credits.

## Mechanism (core-first)

- `RunSpec.api_auth: bool` — wire field, `#[serde(default)]` (absent = `false`). `false` (default) = strip; `true` = inherit the environment untouched.
- The four exec plan builders (`rust/spawnllm-core/src/plan/{claude,codex,gemini,antigravity}.rs`) emit `ExecPlan.env_unset` from the shared consts in `rust/spawnllm-core/src/auth.rs`:
  - claude: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`
  - codex: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `CODEX_API_KEY` (the documented `codex exec` env-key path)
  - gemini: `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`
  - antigravity: `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `ANTIGRAVITY_API_KEY`
  These consts are also the probe `EnvAny` lists and the `capabilities.api_key_vars` map — one definition per provider, never fork them.
- Hosts apply the strip before the plan/spec env overlays: Python `spawnllm/backends/base.py` (filtered `os.environ` seed), Rust `rust/spawnllm/src/exec.rs` (`env_remove`), Go `go/exec.go` (`mergeEnv` seed-skip; case-insensitive + overlay-eviction on Windows only). An explicit `RunSpec.env` entry always survives.
- `ClaudeSdkBackend` can't remove vars (the claude-agent-sdk overlays `options.env` onto the parent env), so it **blanks them to ""**, sourcing the list from `capabilities.api_key_vars["claude"]` — never a hardcoded host copy.

## Deliberate boundaries (don't "fix" these)

- **Auth probes see the ambient env by design** (`run_probe` passes no `env=`): they are non-billing status checks, and the Gemini family's ready-via-key semantics depend on it. Consequence: an api-key-only Gemini/Antigravity setup reports ready but default runs strip the key — those users pass `api_auth=True`.
- **The macOS keychain helper** (`security find-generic-password`) inherits the ambient env; it is a system binary that consults no provider keys.
- `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` is subscription auth and is **never stripped**.
- `ClaudeSdkBackend`'s `isolated=True` means settings/MCP hermeticity only (no fresh `CLAUDE_CODE_CONFIG` seeding) — documented in its docstring; full parity is an open follow-up.

## Adding a provider

A new exec provider MUST ship its `auth.rs` const, its plan builder's `env_unset` wiring, and its `api_key_vars` capabilities entry together, then regenerate vectors (`cargo run -p conformance-gen -- --write`) and rebuild the blob (`task blob`). The tradeoff (security vs convenience) is resolved: default-strip, explicit `api_auth=True` opt-in — do not weaken the default for a new provider.
ops.when: Before modifying env handling in call_sync/call/extract, exec plan dispatch, or changing api_auth defaults; before adding new providers
